Definition: from G4862 and G4682; to rend completely, i.e. (by analogy) to convulse violently:--throw down.
BiblicalUsage: The word pictures a demon throwing a boy down and convulsing him violently. Mark shows it happening as the boy is brought to Jesus, and Luke shows the same scene, the demon tearing at him as he comes. In both tellings the violence is the point: this is what the evil spirit does to its victim.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe these two verses show why Jesus' authority matters so much: where the demon tears down, Jesus lifts up, and the boy walks away whole.
